sourceMigrationLedger.trustedSource: Origin backup record supplied through the same trusted channel as the ciphertext digest; never derive expected values from the restored database.
sourceMigrationLedger.digest: SHA-256 of version + TAB + file + TAB + sha256, sorted by version COLLATE C and joined with LF, without trailing LF.
sourceMigrationLedger.note: Count and ledger digest must describe the source dump. This tool does not attest how the source backup record was captured or authenticated.
sourceMigrationLedger.producerStatus: R42 implements a persistent read-only repeatable-read session and a shared migration lock; pg_dump imports its exported snapshot. New manifests carry snapshot.migrationLedger authenticated by the existing local HMAC. Native multi-process capture/restore is not certified here. The restorer still requires a trusted origin record and keeps sourceMigrationLedgerCaptureVerified:false. Legacy backups retain the trusted coherent manual-source path; never infer the source ledger from the repository or restored target.
